messages:
Marta G: Heads-up: SI field kickoff tomorrow 09:00 PT. Quick checklist before we go live — hardware kits, marketplace listing, and a short demo. Can we confirm status in this thread?
Leo: Shipping update: all kits out. One shows delayed on carrier side but vendor is dispatching a spare. Tracking: https://ship.example.com/XYZ789. ETA tonight.
Sam K: I\'ll provision lab accounts. Need two usernames per SI (engineer + infra). Post them here or DM me.
Marta G: Copy. Also pasting the minimal smoke steps the field team will run so we can align support:
```
- verify NVIDIA driver >= 525
- runtime v2.4.1 install
- load model: rdlw-small-v1.2
- run smoke: python tests/smoke.py --batch 1 --seq 1024
- sanity: curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \
  https://api.redwood/infer -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
Jenna P: Marketplace draft created. Legal requested a one-paragraph privacy blurb + partner logo (SVG) and a short data-flow diagram. Can we get those today?
Leo: Marketing also requested a 7-min demo script + two screenshots. Partner agreed to co-announce if dry-run is green.
Sam K: I can do the demo script and a 3-min walkthrough clip by 16:00. Will include exact SDK calls and expected p95 latencies for the config we\'re shipping.
deploy-bot: Action required: create branch `si/field-kickoff` after demo assets uploaded.
Marta G: Action list (TL;DR):
- Leo: deliver partner press contact + SVG logo by EOD
- Sam K: demo script + video by 16:00; lab creds by 15:00
- Jenna P: chase Legal on marketplace privacy snippet; attach data-flow for security review
- Marta G: run dry-run 16:30 PT, lead runbook walkthrough
Any red flags?
Leo: Kit #4 missing a PCIe riser; vendor overnighting replacement. Shouldn\'t block dry-run unless carrier delays.
Jenna P: Legal flagged the need to show no PII leaves the SI lab. I\'ll get Security to sign off on the diagram.
Sam K: I\'ll make a minimal diagram and attach it to the marketplace entry. Also uploading demo script: https://drive.redwood/si-kickoff/demo-v1.pdf
Marta G: If anything slips, fallback = soft launch of listing without press. Keep updates confined to this thread so the on-call can follow. :thumbsup:
Leo: Will update when kit delivered.
Sam K: Demo assets uploaded. Branch `si/field-kickoff` please.
deploy-bot: Branch `si/field-kickoff` created at commit abcdef1 by CI.
Marta G: Perfect. See everyone at 16:30 for the dry-run.
Jenna P: I\'ll post the marketplace short blurb here once Legal OKs it.
